answer.rationale: p99 latency spiking 5x target 2 hours post-release during peak settlement traffic strongly suggests the release introduced regression. memory_b1 confirms rollback cleared a similar checkout error spike without customer impact; memory_b6 confirms staged gating can catch bad builds. Rollback is fastest path to known-stable state. Circuit breaker (memory_b4) would degrade settlement experience. Read replica routing (memory_b5) addresses dashboard load, not write path latency. Failover and capacity are slower and don't address likely root cause. Small guarded test preserves rollback option if root cause is elsewhere. Peak settlement window means write loss is catastrophic; rollback minimizes that risk by reverting to stable build.
